## Image Loader 0.5.2

The final legacy 0.5-series release.

### Included

- PNG/JPEG URL loading.
- Vanilla block and Exact RGB conversion.
- Alpha-aware transparent-cell placement.
- Image placement preview and cancellation.
- Aspect-ratio controls.
- Gallery Mode with noclip and zoom.
- Void Gallery world generation.
- Exact RGB world persistence and multiplayer synchronization.
- Map/minimap Exact RGB display.
- Fullbright image placements.

### Compatibility

This is a preserved legacy package for the matching Terraria 1.4.4 tModLoader preview build. New installations should use the latest compatible release.
